cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave the meeting, tell the room I decide what happens next. Please complete the handover.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the seating arrangement. We still need the announcement. Use my name, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To the room, please: 'Jo decides what happens next.' Loud enough for the people at the back.

reason: Replace explanatory future chasing consequence with a direct audience and volume instruction that completes the requested public transfer.
